cost: Retain training instrumented applications, raw/merged profiles, compiler and wall times, all builds, initialization (source hashing, upstream checks, project copy), run and combined whole-qualification times, monitor/switch/recovery observations. Acquisition and human labor not measured.
fairness: identical queue roundtrip, exact byte comparison, CRC recurrence, input and scalar ABI; C/C++ LTO/PGO may optimize normally; safe Rust Vec and RAII C++ client; no original C bodies linked into HIA
held_out_policy: New seed and larger input fixed before the first performance run of this follow-up; prior 112-sample negative trial is retained separately. No arm selection or post hoc outlier removal.
maintenance: separately add and capture a versioned scalar CRC helper; original upstream sources remain byte-identical
ordering: rotate arms by group plus algorithm index; reverse odd groups
pgo: HIA, C and C++ actual LLVM IR counters via -fprofile-generate; both algorithms train on same 65537-byte input; profile merge, unique target function, exact counter-list length and positive unsigned-u64 target block counter required; stored block counters are not entry invocation counts. -fprofile-use with stale/unprofiled warnings as errors. Existing frontend C/C++ PGO and Rust PGO arms remain.
positive_gate: All functional/resource checks pass; prospectively selected HIA IR PGO median whole process time and pooled batch P99 no greater than fastest strong C/C++/Rust arm for both algorithms. A separate gate additionally requires child wait4 median RSS no greater. Descriptive shared-host finite observation only.
refusal: VM, C, default HIA and a separate HIA IR PGO observer binary must match allocations, failure returns and cleanup for every registered refusal index. The observer uses the same LLVM/profile with O3/full-LTO/native-CPU compile and link, plus wrap/fno-builtin instrumentation; it is not the performance DSO itself.
same_core: Canonical Core and emitted LLVM files are bound to fresh emission before and after each research HIA build and checked again before measurement and at completion. Trusted-host file binding does not prove compiler or native refinement.
retention: exact consumed Clang AST stdout, captured source, contracts, generated Hepta, Core, LLVM, native artifacts, command streams and all samples
rss: all application arms execute through the same small C fork/exec supervisor; wait4 child peak and pre-exec floor retained; no process bound claim
sampling: no outlier removal, retries or arm changes after observing registered performance
scope: unchanged Ring-Buffer and generic musl comparison bodies, plus an authored CRC helper and owned integration client in a real file-checksum CLI
target: Linux x86-64 LP64; current research host, dot not observable
